statusBanner.text: We are investigating elevated latency on the audio node.

recentIncidents.title: Elevated Latency on Audio Node
recentIncidents.description: Users experienced response times above 300ms for approximately 12 minutes. Root cause was a temporary upstream network congestion. All systems returned to normal.

recentIncidents.title: AI Chat Intermittent Errors
recentIncidents.description: A subset of /ask requests returned errors due to an upstream model API timeout. The issue was resolved by rerouting to a secondary endpoint.
